evidence.title: Kickresume | Best Online Resume & Cover Letter Builder

name: Kickresume
summary: Online resume and cover letter builder with AI writing, ATS checking, resume tailoring and 40+ designer templates.
description: Web app to build resumes, cover letters and resume websites: pick a template, let AI write, rewrite, translate or give feedback, tailor each resume to a job description and check its ATS score. Also includes a job board, interview-question generator, career map, LinkedIn import and iOS/Android apps. Free plan; Premium starts at $5/month.
contains: 40 customizable resume templates and 40 matching cover letter templates
AI writer, rewriter, translation and resume feedback tools
ATS resume checker and job-description tailoring
job board, interview questions, career map, resignation letter and LinkedIn import
